description.describe_ch: 本課程旨在培養英語演講技巧，此為課堂上與工作中都會用到的重要能力。課程將著重於個人的溝通技巧，提升組織、邏輯推理及聽講能力。每位學生須練習不同目的之演講，並參與同儕互評且提供建議。
description.describe_eh: This course is designed to develop public speaking skills. Public speaking is a vital soft skill- be it used in the classroom or for a presentation at work. Attention will also be given to individual communication activities designed to improve the ability to organize, reason critically, and to listen effectively. Each student will develop and deliver several speeches and participate in peer evaluations.

targets.describe_ch: 能辨認並評估具有社會重要性的主題，並針對這些主題做口頭報告。
targets.describe_en: Identify and assess socially significant topics, and then deliver oral presentations on these topics.

targets.describe_ch: 能在口語溝通時，分析談話內容。
targets.describe_en: Engage in critical listening and speaking.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1. Be on time. 請準時上課。
2. Participate in class discussion and class activities. 請參與課堂討論及課堂活動。 
3. Students must submit a leave application to the school in advance, stating the reason for the leave and the expected duration.學生必須提前向學校提交請假申請，說明請假的原因和預計時間。
4. Please purchase original textbook, following intellectual property law. 請購買正版課本，請勿使用複製版本。
5. The texts and exercises will be completed in class. Please bring textbooks to class. 請上課攜帶課本，以利上課活動使用。
6. Follow the school rules to apply for a make-up exam within three days of the exam date. Relevant documents are required for the application. No-shows or those with late application will receive ZERO. The date of a make-up exam will be arranged by the instructor. 若須要補考的同學，請遵照學校學則第二十六條的補考規定，在考試後的3天內提出申請。若考試當天沒有出現或者是沒有申請補考的同學，考試成績一律0分。
7. Following the FCU Exam Regulations, cheaters will receive ZERO for their exams and such cases will be reviewed by the Student Reward and Disciplinary Committee. 考試請遵照考場規定，若作弊者以0分計算，並移請學生獎懲委員會議處。



***** 逢甲大學學則
第二十六條 學生考核請假獲准之補考規定如下：

一、學生因故不能參加各項考核者，須依逢甲大學學生請假辦法完成請假程序，經任課教師核准後由任課教師辦理補考事宜。相關規定如下；
(一) 若補考未到者，不得再行補考；但因懷孕、分娩、育嬰、親喪、重病或其他重大事故，持有證明經任課教師核准後由任課教師辦理補考事宜。
(二) 學生須在該科考核結束後三日內完成請假程序。

二、學生因懷孕、分娩、育嬰、親喪、重病 (COVID-19不算重大疾病)、依法得申請之公假或公務不能參加各項考核者，需檢具區域級以上醫院或分設診所之診斷證明書、喪假證明文件、依法得申請公假之證明文件，或有關單位主管簽證，並依逢甲大學學生請假辦法之規定，完成請假程序，經核准後由任課教師辦理補考事宜，其補考成績以實得分數計。

註１：若學生請假原因非本校學則第二十六條所列，外語教學中心決議其補考成績為實得分數打八折計。
註２：COVID-19不算重大疾病

Make-up Exam Policy for Students with Approved Leave (Midterm/Final Exam)
Article 26 The rules for students obtaining leave and permission to take make-up examinations are as follows:

1. Students who cannot participate in assessments for any reason must complete the procedures for leave per the University's regulations on leaves of absence for students, and have their make-up examinations handled by the instructor once the instructor approves. The regulations are as follows:
(1) If a student fails to take a make-up examination, he/she will not be allowed to retake a make-up examination; however, for students who cannot take a make-up examination due to pregnancy, childbirth, child-rearing, bereavement, serious illness, or other major accidents, they are to provide certification. The instructor will handle their second make-up examination once the instructor approves.
(2) Leave procedures must be completed within three days after the end of the course assessment.

2. If a student is unable to participate in any assessment due to pregnancy, childbirth, child-rearing, bereavement, serious illness, or official leave that can be applied for by law or official duties, he/she must present a certificate of diagnosis from a hospital at or above the regional level or an associated clinic, a certificate of bereavement, a certificate of application for official leave that can be applied for by law, or a visa issued by the supervisor of the unit in charge, and then complete leave procedures in accordance with the University's regulations on students' obtaining leaves. Once their leave is approved, the instructor will conduct a make-up examination. The grade of the make-up examination is to be based on the actual score.

Note 1: If a student's reason for taking leave is not included under Article 26 of the University Regulations, the Foreign Language Center has decided that the student's make-up exam score will be calculated at 80% of the actual score obtained.
Note 2:　COVID-19 is not considered a serious illness.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
1.	Respect: You are encouraged to attend class regularly and participate in class activities, but don’t monopolize conversations. Disrespectful comments or behavior will not be tolerated. Please contact me immediately if you ever feel like the class atmosphere is not respectful toward you or your peers. On speech day, kindly remember to listen at the classroom door before entering. Never, never, never enter the classroom while a student or guest is speaking. Don’t ever sleep in class, either. Please respect each other and your instructor.
2.	Technology: Phones must be put away during class. Tablet or laptop computers may be used for class-related material and note-taking. I may change this policy if computers become distracting,
3.	Attendance: Attendance is counted from the first week. Please be aware that skipping classes will jeopardize your overall course grade. Also, sleeping in class is regarded as an absence. 
4.	Missed Speeches/ Late assignments: No late or makeup work will not be accepted unless in the event of a documented emergency.
5.	Academic Integrity: Proper citation of sources is required. Copying or using others' work (including AI tools) without full acknowledge is considered plagiarism.

綜合說明
  1. Students must exhibit honesty and ethical behavior in their academic activities, avoiding plagiarism and falsification of data. 學生在學術活動中必須展現誠實和道德行為，避免抄襲和篡改資料。
